name: Thinking Orb
description: Interactive 2D dotted thought-orb indicator with 9 animated AI states and tactile click cycling.
summary: An animated indicator for AI agent UIs, copilot status indicators and loaders. Powered by thinking-orbs, it renders nine orbital particle states (breathing, searching, working, solving, listening, connecting, weaving, composing, shaping) on a 2D canvas, with click-to-cycle interactivity and two size presets.
highlights: Nine hand-tuned agent animation states: breathing, searching, working, solving, listening, connecting, weaving, composing, shaping
Interactive click-to-cycle state transition with tactile hover and active scaling
Two size presets (64 and 20) with an optional display size override
High-efficiency 2D HTML5 canvas rendering without WebGL or heavy shader pipeline overhead
Hydration-safe dynamic loader with automatic offscreen pause and reduced motion support
anatomy: <button> (Interactive trigger with tactile scale and focus ring; an aria-hidden span when not interactive)
<canvas> (2D particle simulation rendering the orbital paths)

physics.description: Mathematical trigonometric orbits and particle velocity vectors running through a unified shared frame clock.

accessibility.aria: The button carries an aria-label with the current state and the click action ("Orb state is breathing. Click to cycle state."). With interactive={false} and no onClick it renders an aria-hidden span instead.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Renders a static representative frame with zero loop computation.

recommended: AI agent and copilot status indicators in navigation headers and sidebars
Loading and thinking states during generative tasks and deep reasoning queries
Interactive state selectors and futuristic feedback elements
bestPractices: Use size={20} for inline indicators and size={64} for avatars
Set interactive={false} for a non-interactive, aria-hidden indicator
Control the state with state and onStateChange

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled orb animation state (breathing, searching, working, solving, listening, connecting, weaving, composing, shaping).

props.name: size
props.description: Authoring tuning preset and canvas buffer resolution.

props.name: display
props.description: CSS dimensions to render the orb at in pixels.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Whether clicking cycles through orb states with tactile feedback.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the orb element.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the animation on the current frame.

props.name: theme
props.description: Ink treatment for dark or light backgrounds. "auto" follows the color scheme.

props.name: color
props.description: Optional ink tint color (hex or rgb). Defaults to white on dark substrates.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Callback fired on click with event and next state.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Called with the next state when an interactive click changes it.
